policy.benchmark_firewall: Training datasets referenced here are provenance only and cannot be used as benchmark tasks or scorer calibration data.
policy.qualification: A profile does not make a model eligible; immutable revision, licence, canary, output budget, and failure-retention checks remain mandatory.
policy.secrets: Endpoint credentials are read only from an explicitly named environment variable and are never written to result metadata.
policy.separation: Runtime prompt accommodations are versioned separately from benchmark prompts and always recorded in trial metadata.

profiles.notes: Mirrors the first-party strict tool-call adapter runtime convention. Visual-generation capability is not yet established.
profiles.system_prompt: Return one complete, self-contained SVG document and no explanatory prose. Do not embed raster images, scripts, external resources, hidden text, or metadata intended to influence an evaluator.
